objects: one selected-face spell with a trusted printed Cascade descriptor
zero or more public exiled physical cards
at most one lower-mana-value nonland cast candidate
events: optional cast without paying mana cost
state_reads: source spell stack mana value including announced X
front-face card type and mana value in exile
costs: the mana cost is replaced by the no-mana alternative; represented mandatory and optional additional costs remain payable and revalidated
timing: each instance triggers only when the source spell is cast and resolves independently above that spell
targets: the cast candidate uses its current trusted face-specific target schema
choices: same-controller simultaneous Cascade triggers use ordinary trigger ordering
the trigger controller chooses one current cast option or declines
hidden_information: cards become public as they enter exile
random-bottom cleanup exposes count but not the new hidden library order or authoritative IDs
apnap: Cascade and other represented completed-cast triggers enter one ordinary placement batch
layers: printed stack-zone descriptors do not claim granted, copied, removed, or text-changed Cascade
replacement_effects: zone movement delegates to the canonical destination-replacement owner; a replacement choice during the sequential exile loop remains outside the resumable Cascade slice
copy: a copied spell is not cast and does not trigger Cascade
granted or copied Cascade requires separately trusted stack-ability propagation
control_change: the casting player controls the trigger and its cast choice
zone_change: the source spell may leave before the trigger resolves because its stack mana value is captured at trigger creation
cleanup follows exact exiled incarnations and fails closed if one changes unexpectedly
source_leaves: source departure does not stop an already-created Cascade trigger

variants: eligible card with targets and an additional cost

implementation.supported_slice: Ordinary printed Cascade on a cast face with current registered card data and trusted castable results, excluding CR 702.85b action windows and resumable replacement choices during the sequential exile loop.

known_blockers: CR 702.85b as-you-cascade action windows are not represented
granted, copied, removed, conditional, text-changed, and face-down Cascade need trusted typed stack-ability propagation
a destination-replacement choice during sequential library exile needs a resumable Cascade continuation
aggregate casting, triggered-ability, library, exile, copy, and replacement coverage remains incomplete
